notes: MedS-Bench (Wu et al., npj Digit Med 2024; arXiv 2408.12547) recasts the dataset as an instruction task. Henrychur/MedS-Bench holds the full test files ("the official benchmark"); Henrychur/MedS-Bench-SPLIT holds the subsample used for the paper's results. n_items counts the MedS-Bench file. Only the SPLIT release has the summarization tasks; Henrychur/MedS-Bench has no Text_summarization folder. MedS-Ins has a training version (task110), not downloaded. Inputs concatenate the titles and abstracts of several RCTs (median about 4,350 characters). Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.

rendering.rule: instruction-style (MedS-Bench): the task Definition, a blank line, then the instance input (few-shot examples and outputs omitted)
rendering.template_source: none (instruction and input as released in the MedS-Bench task files)
